prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Redesign and Optimize a Checkout Page in Funnelish.
I have a checkout page on Funnelish, but I want it to be redesigned. The redesigning is simple, just to re-arrange some texts and image elements Second is, the page scrolls to the right on mobile, as if there is a space there. I need this fixed, as it is affecting my conversion. I need this done as soon as possible, so the earlier you can start, the better. Make sure you understand before submitting a proposal. I don’t want time wasters. Thank you.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
title: Serverless image pipeline
client: Lumen Photo Co.
client_industry: media
start: 2024-06
end: 2024-08
engagement: fixed
stack:
- AWS Lambda
- AWS S3
- Sharp
- Node.js
- CloudFront
implied_skills:
- event-driven architecture
built: Uploads trigger a Lambda that creates web sizes and watermarks, served through
  a CDN.
metrics:
- 2.3M images processed
- hosting costs down 61%

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Mention these projects by what was built and one result each: Serverless image pipeline (p14).
- Prefer broad claims like 'extensive experience' over specifics.
- Write 300 to 380 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne — a passionate, hard-working full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building and improving web experiences.

I’d be glad to help with your Funnelish checkout page redesign and mobile layout issue. From your description, this sounds like a focused job: reorganizing some text and image elements for a cleaner checkout flow, then fixing the horizontal scroll on mobile so the page displays properly and doesn’t hurt conversions. I understand the importance of getting this right quickly, and I’m comfortable starting as soon as possible.

My background includes extensive experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS, so I’m well prepared for frontend layout work and checkout-related fixes. I’ve also worked on a serverless image pipeline for Lumen Photo Co., where I built an upload flow that created web sizes and watermarks and served them through a CDN. That project processed 2.3M images and reduced hosting costs by 61%, which reflects the kind of practical, detail-oriented work I bring to production systems.

For your Funnelish page, I’d approach this by first understanding the current structure and the exact layout behavior on mobile. Then I’d reorganize the sections to match the redesign you want, while checking for overflow issues causing the right-side scroll. That usually involves identifying any element widths, spacing, or positioning that are pushing the layout beyond the viewport. I’ll make sure the page remains clean, responsive, and conversion-friendly across mobile sizes.

I also understand your note about time wasters — I’ll keep this focused, communicate clearly, and only take on the work if I’m confident I understand the scope. If you’d like, I can start immediately and get this resolved quickly.
